intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: A breeze comes through an open window. Tavri lifts her chin, ready to say something grand about it.

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “The wind, like the ambitions of kings, is restless and—”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Her ears tip back to catch more of it.

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “The kings can find their own breeze.”

options.labelText: “It *is* nice. Let’s stand in it for a bit.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: You stand in it. It is, as reported, nice.

branch.speaker: TAVRI
branch.text: “Look at us. Two people, one window, no subtext.”

options.labelText: “Ooh, my turn. The wind is like the job market: it never tells you which way it’s going.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She nods at your metaphor the way she nods at ambassadors. The breeze moves on without either of you.
